owner.law: Each order instance owns its complete ordered member-pointer vector. A division may occur in more than one order-owned vector; no inverse single-pointer field can replace enumeration of these vectors.

container.law: Assignment and unassignment command execution enumerate the owning orders-group vectors and the COrderInstance child topology before touching member vectors.

assignment_call_chain.role: Caller enumerates army/group units, constructs COrderAssignCommand for the target order's +0x244 identity, validates it, and executes it.
COrderAssignCommand constructor filters selected CUnit references against the target group and stores the exact target group handle and order-instance id.
COrderAssignCommand executor resolves the COrdersGroup, enumerates its order vectors/child topology, selects by current per-order membership counts, and calls the central mutator.
Central assignment mutator searches existing memberships across +0x1f8/+0x204 child orders, refreshes the owning group, and appends the member to every selected order-owned vector.
Per-order append validates pMember ownership against COrderInstance+0x38, rejects duplicates in +0x210/+0x21c, then appends the pointer to that vector.
Counts a group's units present in one COrderInstance+0x210/+0x21c vector and is consumed by the assignment selector.

removal_call_chain.role: COrderUnassignCommand executor resolves COrdersGroup and passes both +0x98 and +0xb0 order containers to its walker.
Unassign walker resolves each selected CUnit and applies recursive member removal to every order in the supplied group container.
Removes the member from COrderInstance+0x210 and the separate +0x228 support vector, then recursively applies the same removal to all +0x1f8 children.

negative_proof.reason: The complete producer/mutator route reads and writes order-owned +0x210/+0x21c vectors through COrdersGroup enumeration. It never enumerates membership through CDivision+0xc8, which remains a current/primary-order link only.

production_audit.reason: The current D54 reader already walks each admitted order, reads +0x210/+0x21c, validates each CDivision pointer and typed stable handle, preserves engine order, carries children in the 60/88 wire, folds by exact order identity, and emits assigned_division_ids per order. Adding a speculative inverse division field or reading +0xc8 would reduce fidelity.

exact10_promotion_gate.required_matching_rule: Every promoted function entry must be an exact requested member of a successful consolidated exact-ten request; an incidental depth child is insufficient.
exact10_promotion_gate.after_receipt: Replace fresh discovery hashes only after exact request membership, broker request hash, selected shard, binary identity, artifact path, and artifact SHA-256 all match the new final receipt.

remaining_non_static_acceptance.reason: The owner/container/caller route and production reader are complete, but retained streams predate the 60/88 wire and cannot prove same-boundary live/save equality or add/remove delta behavior.
